review_status: Evidence reviewed 2026-11-17. North Pacific survey models support species-specific marine SST habitat; the configured band is partly aligned but shifted warm, and seafloor depth is only a weak proxy.

profile.size: Min limit 16-20 inches TL / Bag limit 2 per harvester / day (hatchery)
profile.diet: Small fish, crustaceans, squids, and pelagic prey
profile.behavior: Navigates West Coast kelp forests, rocky reefs, and coastal upwelling zones.

factors.reason_template: Water is {value} C, inside preferred Pacific temperature range for coho salmon.
factors.value_notes: Langan et al. (2024) modeled coho marine preferred SST at 6.1-13.2 °C (80% HDI), core 7.2-11.0 °C, median 9.5 °C and modal 8.9 °C from North Pacific survey data (1953-2022). The configured 7-15 °C range overlaps much of the modeled interval, but the 9-13 °C ideal is weighted toward its warmer edge. Stock, migration timing and regional conditions remain important; this is not a local coastal catch-rate curve.

factors.reason_template: Depth is {value} m, within prime Pacific depth zone for coho salmon.
factors.value_notes: Coho spend their marine phase foraging in coastal and open North Pacific waters, with some stocks remaining near natal streams and others migrating long distances. The runtime variable is seafloor bathymetry, not fish vertical depth; no reviewed source establishes a universal 0-60 m bottom-depth preference. Retain as a weak coastal/offshore proxy only.

text.day: Full daylight when Pacific gamefish actively hunt.

timing.note: West Coast captain reports and biological upwelling patterns.
